name: India GST Collections Dashboard
bullets: Combined 10 yearly GST portal Excel files with changing layouts (merged month headers, 5 vs 4 tax columns, text state codes) into a 12,849-row fact table using a Power Query function

Modelled the data as a GST fact table with state, tax-head and April-March calendar tables, wrote DAX for year-on-year growth, state share and top-5 share, and matched every figure to a separate pandas recount of the raw files
Found collections doubled to ₹16.32 lakh crore in 2025-26 while yearly growth slowed from 26.9% to 6.4%, and the top 5 states' share rose from 52.2% to 55.6%
